title: gregllm
tagline: A Claude Code skill that answers "what will this GregTech: New Horizons build cost?" down to raw materials.
highlights: Expands multiblocks and batch crafts over real GTNH 2.9.0 recipe data (~93 MB) into raw materials, EU/t, duration and total EU
Picks the cheapest recipe chain under your voltage tier, then Claude confirms each choice with you
Downloads the recipe data on first run and verifies it against a pinned hash; no npm dependencies
Plan files pin recipe choices so a cost breakdown can be reproduced
role: Solo: calculator, data pipeline, Claude Code skill
problem: In GregTech: New Horizons a single machine can hide hundreds of crafting steps across many tiers of recipes. Players plan builds in spreadsheets. I wanted to just ask "what will this cost?" and get the full raw-material bill, power use and leftovers.

challenges.title: A recipe graph with real choices
challenges.body: Most items have several recipes and ore-dictionary slots that accept many items. With --auto the calculator picks the cheapest chain under your voltage tier, then Claude confirms those picks with you, and plan files pin them so the answer can be reproduced.

challenges.title: Data the repo isn't allowed to ship
challenges.body: The recipe export has no license and contains game content, so the repo doesn't include it. A setup script downloads a pinned copy and verifies its hash on first run.

challenges.title: Keeping the LLM honest
challenges.body: Claude never does the arithmetic. The skill tells it to run the scripts, ask for your tier, and surface each assumption before giving a final answer.
